name: Santa Claus
body:
SANTA CLAUS
CR 30/MR 10

XP 9,830,400
Male venerable half-celestial human conjurer (creation) 20/VMC cleric/archmage 10
LG Medium outsider (mythic, native)
Init +15, amazing initiative; Senses aura sight, darkvision 60 ft., Perception +37
Aura good, law

DEFENSE

AC 41, touch 20, flat-footed 36 (+13 armor, +5 deflection, +5 Dex, +8 natural)
hp 302 (20d6+200+30) +20 temporary hp (greater heroism)
Fort +15, Ref +15, Will +21. +4 racial vs. poison
Defensive Abilities force of will, hard to kill, immortal, mythic saves, recuperation, unstoppable; DR 10/magic; Immune disease, fear; Resist acid, cold, and electricity 10; SR 35

OFFENSE

Speed 30, fly 60 (good)
Melee winter’s reach +21/+16 (1d6+7 +1d6 cold/+1d10 cold)
Special Attacks artificer’s touch 12/day (1d6+10 damage to objects and constructs, bypasses 20 points of DR/hardness), channel positive energy 10/day (9d6, DC 28), greater channel, improved channel, mythic power 23/day, smite evil 1/day (+9 attack, +20/+40 damage), surge +1d12
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th, concentration +29)

At will—mending
10/day—major creation
3/day—holy aura (DC 27), protection from evil
1/day—aid, bless, cure serious wounds, detect evil, dispel evil (DC 24), hallow, holy smite (DC 23), holy word (DC 26), mass charm monster (DC 27), neutralize poison, remove disease, resurrection, summon monster IX (celestials)
1/level/day—animate rope, forbid action (DC 20), protection from chaos, protection from evil, shield of faith, true strike; aid, align weapon (good), align weapon (law), augury, wood shape; borrow fortune, magic circle against chaos, magic circle against evil, protection from energy, stone shape, tongues; freedom of movement, holy smite (DC 23), minor creation, order’s wrath (DC 23); break enchantment, dispel chaos (DC 24), dispel evil (DC 24), fabricate, greater forbid action (DC 24); blade barrier (DC 25), hold monster (DC 25), major creation, mislead (DC 25), planar ally (angels); dictum (DC 26), holy word (DC 26), limited wish (DC 26), spell turning, wall of iron (DC 26); holy aura (DC 27), moment of prescience, polymorph any object (DC 27), shield of law (DC 27), statue; mass hold monster (DC 28), miracle (DC 28), prismatic sphere (DC 28), summon monster IX (good), summon monster IX (lawful)

Wizard Spells Prepared (CL 20th, concentration +34)

9th Level—astral projection, bilocation, gate, prismatic sphere (DC 35), summon monster IX, time stopM, wishM (DC 33)
8th Level—demand (DC 32), euphoric tranquility (DC 32), greater instant summons, greater planar ally, mass charm monster (DC 32), prismatic wall (DC 32), summon monster VIII
7th Level—banishment (DC 31), greater teleport, joyful rapture, mass invisibility bubble, prismatic sprayM (DC 31), summon monster VII, vision
6th Level—animate objectsM, contingencyM, dream reality (DC 30), dream scan (DC 30), greater dispel magic, geas/quest (DC 30), getaway, globe of invulnerability, summon monster VI
5th Level—army across time, break enchantment, fabricate, hold monster (DC 29), icy prison (DC 31), mage’s faithful hound, major creation, scintillating wall (DC 29), teleport, touch of slumber (DC 29)
4th Level—brightest light, charm monster (DC 28), creeping ice (DC 30), dimension door, greater celestial healing, greater invisibility, greater make whole, hypercognition, ice storm, locate creature, phantom chariot, wall of ice (DC 30)
3rd Level—allied cloak, arcane sight, blinkM, daylight, deep slumber (DC 27), detect desires (DC 27), dispel magic, haste, hold person (DC 27), nondetection, phantom steed, sleet storm
2nd Level—apport object, arcane lock, continual flame, detect thoughts (DC 26), flurry of snowballs (DC 28), frost fall (DC 28), glitterdust (DC 26), grace, hideous laughterM (DC 26), ice slick, knock, locate object, make whole, spider climb
1st Level—alarm, arcane pocket, charm person (DC 25), chastise, clarion call, command (DC 25), heightened awareness, hold portal, icicle dagger, identify, preserve, see alignment, shield, sleep (DC 25), snowball
0th-Level—arcane mark, dancing lights, detect magic, mage hand, message, read magic

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 21, Con 25, Int 38, Wis 29, Cha 28
Base Atk +10; CMB +14; CMD 29
Feats Alertness*, Blissful Spell*, Elemental FocusM (cold), Eschew MaterialsM, Extend Spell*, Extra Path AbilityM, Leadership, Rime Spell*, Scribe Scroll*, ToughnessM, Versatile Summon Monster*
Skills Appraise +41, Craft +41, Diplomacy +38, Escape Artist +31, Fly +38, Handle Animal +33, Knowledge (religion) +46, Knowledge (arcana, dungeoneering, geography, history, local, nature, planes) +41, Perception +37, Sense Motive +37, Spellcraft +41
Languages Celestial, Common, Draconic, Dutch, Dwarven, Elven, English, Finnish, French, Giant, Gnome, Halfling, Italian, Russian; truespeak
SQ animate servant 4/day (20 rounds), arcane bond (familiar), arcane discovery (immortality), archmage arcana (wild arcana), crafting mastery, create gear 27/day (20 pounds), creator’s will 10/day, divine source x3 (Artifice/Construct, Good/AngelBL1, Law/Legislation, Luck/Fate), domain (Artifice/Construct), enduring armor, exceptional stats, harmonious mage, improved domain, legendary hero, mythic arcane school (power)BL6, mythic contingency, mythic spellcasting, omniscient bishop, sanctum, speedy summons, spontaneous casting, star walker, summoner’s charm (10 rounds), true archmage, well-prepared
Gear belt of physical perfection +6 (144,000 gp), boots of spider climbing (as the slippers, 4,800 gp), mitre of the hierophant (18,000 gp), ring of splendid securityP12CoF (180,000 gp), Santa’s cap (as a headband of mental superiority +6, 144,000 gp), ring of regeneration (90,000 gp), rod of giant summoning (11,000 gp), Santa’s list, Santa’s bottomless sack, Santa’s sleigh, winter’s reach (228,000 gp). In addition to these, Santa Claus can have access to many other magic items at the GM’s discretion.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Exceptional Stats (Ex)

Santa Claus’s stats were generated using a 25-point buy. Additionally, he has the equipment of a PC of the same level, plus his unique magic sack, list scroll, and sleigh. These modifications increase his CR by 2.

Familiar Cohort

Santa Claus’ cohort is a hoary muntjac barbarian 11/champion 5. The monster cohort also serves as Santa Claus’ familiar, and possesses all the abilities of a 20th-level familiar.

Followers

Santa Claus’ followers (per Mythic Leadership) are gnomes, dwarves, and elves with levels in alchemist, arcanist, bard, wizard, and chronicler and ranks in Craft, and are daily employed in his sanctum-workshop manufacturing toys and other gifts. The 10 higher-level followers are also 1st-tier archmages with the Crafting Mastery ability path.

Mythic Contingency

Whenever Santa Claus is attacked, he is affected by cat’s grace, frosty aura, globe of invulnerability, greater celestial healing, sanctuary, and shield.

Omniscient Bishop

Santa Claus is under the permanent effect of mythic deathless, aura sight, greater heroism, ironskin, and truespeak. Any temporary effects of these spells renew every day. Santa Claus also knows all wizard and cleric spells, and has researched many druid spells. These abilities increase his CR by 1.

Permanent Summons

Santa Claus has two permanent mythic summon monster IX spells in place thanks to Mythic Arcane School (power) and has used them to summon the 8 awakened agile reindeer that pull his sleigh. Each one of them has the abilities of a 7th-level ranger (skirmisher) and the gear of a summoned creature of equivalent level.

ABOUT

An eminent ecclesiastic and saint on his native world in the Material Plane, Nicholas was famous in life for his generosity towards the poor and especially children.

He achieved communion with the divine and immortality after a very long life and his wish to continue his earthly work of rewarding good children was granted. Now he is worshiped under diverse forms and names on many worlds and planes and invoked by parents as an incitement for children to be well-behaved, in order to receive his gifts.
